evidence.text: John, Count of Brienne (c. 1235 – c. 1260) was the eldest son of Walter IV of Brienne and Marie of Lusignan, a princess of Cyprus.

evidence.title: John, Count of Brienne
evidence.text: He inherited the County of Brienne on his father's death in 1246, but preferred to live among his mother's relatives at the court of Cyprus, and played little part in international politics.

evidence.title: John, Count of Brienne
evidence.text: In 1255, he married Marie, Lady of Thieusies (in Hainaut), the daughter of Sohier II of Enghien.

evidence.title: John, Count of Brienne
evidence.text: They had no children, and when he died, he was succeeded by his brother Hugh.

evidence.title: Yolanda of Lusignan
